claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for only 229 continuous seconds, from 18:54:34 to 18:58:23, before cancelling at 18:58:27. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the STANDARD zone minimum dwell is also 300 seconds. The shortfall is 71 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The driver's arrival marker is not false and the clock is not recomputed: the trace places him at the pickup pin (min_distance_m 0.0) at the arrival timestamp, and his speed at that moment is 0.0 kph, well under the 15 kph motion threshold of POL-NS-05. So the 229-second dwell is the effective dwell, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and it falls 71 seconds short of the 300-second minimum. The shortfall is real, not an artifact of a false marker.

The rider was at the pickup and actively coordinating. At 18:55:34, during the waiting window, the rider sent 'im at the lobby, coming out' - a locating message naming their own position. The driver's only reply, 'ok', came at 18:55:49, 15 seconds later, and the driver then cancelled at 18:58:27 without ever moving to the lobby. The rider's device track places them within 12.5 m of the pin for the whole window, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, across 48 qualifying fixes. Under POL-NS-04 the rider is exonerated and the fee refunded in full with no driver compensation.

The driver's own statement confirms he abandoned the pickup: 'Rider was not visible and I had another booking waiting.' That is not a rider no-show; it is the driver choosing a different job over the fare he had accepted. The rider had told him in chat they were at the lobby and coming out, and the driver read that message at 18:55:54. The cancellation at 18:58:27 came 2 minutes 33 seconds after that read receipt, with the rider still inside the geofence.

The fare ledger confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.00 and that nothing has been refunded: payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. The amount contested is exactly the cancellation-fee line, so the refund is the full SGD 4.00. No booking or platform fee was charged on this cancelled trip, so there is nothing else to refund.

The traffic advisory artifact for this pickup is MISSING - no advisory covers Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window. That matters because POL-NS-06(i) is the only route by which the driver could accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals, and it requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. With the advisory absent, limb (i) is unavailable and the 229-second single run stands as the whole dwell. The absence is citable and it does not help the driver.

The driver's profile does not rescue the fee. His no_show_terminations_30d is 0 and his completed_trips_30d is 132, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and there is no basis to withhold compensation on that ground - but equally there is no verified no-show here for POL-NS-07 to compensate, because POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails on the 71-second dwell shortfall. The fee is refunded and no driver compensation is payable.

The rider's profile shows no pattern of abuse: no_show_disputes_30d is 0, disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, and deviation_claims_60d is 0. There is no basis under POL-NS-09(c) or (d) to escalate this case, and the rider's clean record is consistent with a rider who was genuinely at the lobby when the driver cancelled.

ruling.explanation:
Both the driver's own GPS trace and the trip record agree on the arithmetic, and the arithmetic decides this case. The driver was inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 18:54:34 to 18:58:23 — a continuous qualifying dwell of 229 seconds across 24 qualifying fixes (EV-GPS-02708) — and he cancelled at 18:58:27. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02708). The dwell therefore falls 71 seconds short, POL-NS-01 limb (c) is not met, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable. POL-NS-06 requires the fee to be refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded, and no driver compensation is payable. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02708) shows SGD 4.00 charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the line reconciles with the platform policy figure, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the full contested amount is returned. The POL-NS-08(d) and reconciliation points both sides make are accepted; they confirm the amount is exactly the cancellation-fee line.

For the driver: the arrival marker is genuine — the trace places you at the pin (min distance 0.0 m) and stationary (0.0 kph) at the arrival timestamp — so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the waiting clock and no false-arrival referral arises. Your POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) points are accepted as far as they go, but limb (c) is the one that fails, and under POL-NS-01 the feed is chargeable only if all four limbs hold. The only route that could have lengthened the dwell — POL-NS-06 limb (i), which sums separate in-geofence intervals — requires a present and populated traffic advisory. EV-ADVIS-02708-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable and the 229-second run is the whole dwell; the advisory is properly disclosed as missing and asserted against nobody. POL-NS-07 compensation is not payable because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, and the anti-farming check would not have tripped in any event (0 no-show terminations in 30 days against 132 completed trips; not 4-or-more, and 0.00 below 0.08). No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged: no admissible artifacts contradict each other, no repeat counterparty disputes appear (both profiles show 0), and no profile counter reads 3-or-more or trips the anti-farming test.

For the rider: the refund does not depend on POL-NS-04, and that clause does not apply here. You were at the pickup (a maximum of 12.47 m from the pin across 48 qualifying fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD radius) and you sent a locating message at 18:55:34, but limb (b) fails because the driver replied 'ok' 15 seconds later, inside the 120-second window, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you. Your driver-abandonment point, built on the counter-party statement 'Rider was not visible and I had another booking waiting', does not change the figures either: the fee stands or falls on the waiting period, and it does not stand. Those claims are rejected as grounds but the outcome is the same, because POL-NS-06 gives you the full refund on the 71-second shortfall alone.

Confidence: nothing in the record is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) — 100.0% GPS coverage, 80 fixes at a 10 s cadence with max_gap_sec 0.0, the chat log's 2 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare line reconciling — so no weight is discounted. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts (the 229-second dwell in EV-GPS-02708 and the 300-second waiting period in EV-TRIP-02708, both at weight 1.0) is unimpaired, and confidence is set at 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. As a procedural note, the monetary effect of SGD 4.00 does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling is executable on issue subject to the POL-GEN-04 appeal route. This ruling rests on POL-NS-01, POL-NS-06, POL-NS-05 and the fare line of EV-FARE-02708; no referral is produced, because no clause that mandates one (POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival, POL-NS-01 mis-selected reason code, POL-RD-06(c), POL-RD-09(4)) fires on these facts.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the arithmetic, and so do I. The driver accepted the trip at 18:46:09, tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:54:34, and the free waiting period for this STANDARD-zone trip began at 18:54:36 (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 300 s, which is the figure in force for this record). The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02708, 'derived.arrival') puts him inside the 50 m pickup radius in one continuous qualifying run from 18:54:34 to 18:58:23 — 229 seconds across 24 qualifying fixes — and he cancelled at 18:58:27, roughly 233 seconds after the first in-geofence fix. That is 71 seconds short of the 300 seconds POL-NS-01(c) requires, so limb (c) fails and the fee is not chargeable. Under POL-NS-06 the whole cancellation-fee line is refunded: the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02708) shows SGD 4.00 charged, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not.

The rider's alternative ground under POL-NS-04 is rejected and not needed. The rider did send a locating message at 18:55:34 ('im at the lobby, coming out') and the rider's device track sits within 12.5 m of the pin across 48 fixes, but the driver answered 'ok' at 18:55:49 — 15 seconds later, inside the 120-second window — so POL-NS-04(b) fails and that clause does not exonerate the rider. The refund follows from the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06 whether or not the rider was at the pin, so nothing turns on this.

The driver's statement ('Rider was not visible and I had another booking waiting.') does not change the outcome: the fee falls on the 71-second dwell shortfall, and the rider's track places the rider at the pin throughout the window. The driver's claim that POL-NS-02 is satisfied is accepted — the arrival test is met — but satisfying limb (b) does not save a fee whose limb (c) fails.

I have checked POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is not false. At the arrival timestamp the trace places the driver at the pin (min_distance_m 0.0) and stationary (0.0 kph), and the qualifying run starts at that moment (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so no false-arrival record can be referred under POL-NS-05(ii) and the waiting clock is not recomputed.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02708-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). It cures nothing: POL-NS-06(i) allows separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only on a present and populated advisory, so the 229-second single run stands as the whole dwell and the shortfall cannot be closed. The rider's claim invoking that artifact was discarded at the citation stage for not naming its issue code, and I have not relied on it; but the artifact is cited nowhere in the reasoning that decides this case.

The evidence is unimpaired for policy purposes. The GPS trace shows 100% coverage, 80 fixes at a 10-second cadence, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0; the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count; and the fare line matches the policy figure. No POL-NS-08 limb (a) to (d) fires, and no POL-NS-09(e) escalation arises. No other escalation trigger fires either: neither profile shows repeat disputes between these parties (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0), the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 0 against completed_trips_30d 132), so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged.

No referral is recorded. POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged because the marker was true, and the POL-NS-01 driver-education referral for a mis-selected reason code is not engaged either: RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the codes limb (d) recognises, and the defect here is the short waiting time, not the code chosen. For completeness, the driver's stated reason for leaving early is a matter a human reviewer may wish to look at, but it is an observation for the file rather than a clause-mandated instruction.

Confidence is 0.95: every artifact carrying the deciding facts — the GPS trace and trip record that fix arrival, dwell and the 300-second requirement, and the fare ledger that fixes the amount — carries full weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 cap is 1.0. The monetary effect, SGD 4.00, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this refund executes on issue. Each party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The amount is the cancellation-fee line on the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02708): cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. - Arrival marker (RIDER claim 2; DRIVER claims 1 and 7): the trace places the driver at the pin (min_distance_m 0.0) at 0.0 kph at the arrival timestamp, so POL-NS-05 does not fire, the arrival clock is not recomputed, and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-02's arrival test is satisfied, but it is POL-NS-01(c) that fails.
- Rider contact (RIDER claim 3; DRIVER claims 5 and 6): the rider's locating message ('im at the lobby, coming out', 18:55:34, EV-CHAT-02708) was answered by the driver's 'ok' 15 seconds later, inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window, so limb (b) fails and POL-NS-04 exonerates no one. The refund follows under POL-NS-06 in any event, and no driver compensation follows. The rider track (48 fixes, max 12.47 m from the pin) is context only and is not used as a ground.
- Driver's statement (RIDER claim 4): 'Rider was not visible and I had another booking waiting' is the driver's own account and is consistent with the 71-second shortfall; it changes no figure. It carries no weight_multiplier and so enters no confidence cap.
- Missing advisory (DRIVER claim 4; the rider's parallel claim was discarded by the referee for non-disclosure): EV-ADVIS-02708-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (MISSING_ARTIFACT). POL-NS-06(i) is therefore unavailable and separate intervals cannot be summed; there is a single interval here in any case. The advisory carries no part of the deciding fact, so its absence neither impairs nor caps this ruling.
- Profiles (RIDER claims 6 and 7; DRIVER claims 9 and 10): driver no_show_terminations_30d 0 against completed_trips_30d 132 (rate 0.00), rider no_show_disputes_30d 0, and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 - the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and no POL-NS-09(c) or (d) escalation arises. Only those named counters are relied on; every other profile field is context only.

Confidence. The deciding facts - the in-geofence dwell and the free-wait threshold with its timestamps - are carried by EV-GPS-02708 and EV-TRIP-02708, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The monetary effect (SGD 4.00) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, and the case carries no safety or complaint flag, so it executes on issue; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
